change: The LMART early-stopping / grid-selection statistic, and the LMART exact ranks, resolve TIES exactly as the promoted list resolves them (stable descending sort, equal scores in column order) - i.e. the rank the official evaluator gives the lifted list. The registered text ('the exact fused-rank statistic ... identical to the MLP's epoch criterion') is kept; the v7 implementation of that statistic counts tied candidates as not above the gold, which equals the evaluator's statistic only for tie-free scores (MLP, validated |dMRR| <= 1e-7) but not for tree scores, whose early rounds take only num_leaves distinct values.
disclosure: the first run's log printed the round-1 LMART test MRRs (alone / fused) for polecat TiRGN, smallpedia TiRGN, CognTKE and RE-GCN (TGB); those rows, and the LMART rows of the official files of that run, are discarded. No other setting is changed: same grid, rounds, patience, fixed parameters, fit/select rows, seeds, fusion, contrasts and margin. MLP64_PAT / LIN_PAT and the M4 arms of that run are unaffected (continuous scores, v7 code, official evaluator).
how_detected: validation-only diagnostics of the first LMART run (<HOST> job 69f852c5): best round = 1 at every grid point on polecat TiRGN and CognTKE, with the selection MRR falling after round 1 (0.320 at round 1, 0.27-0.29 at rounds 50-100 on polecat TiRGN), i.e. the optimistic tie count rewarded the coarse round-1 scores.
infrastructure_notes_no_protocol_change: polecat TiRGN replay tree path corrected to tracks/pilot_smallpedia/stage/TiRGN (as v7 official on <HOST>)
G1_xf features and the LMART MLP latency step hit CUDA OOM while the M3a TiRGN training occupied GPU 0; they are re-run unchanged
fixed LMART lists are scored in separate official passes (base tags *_lm2)
